changed: A program imported from a Caller's Companion set is named the way Caller's Companion names it, by date and location, such as "2024/04/20 - NEFFA Contra Party".
An imported Caller's Companion set no longer repeats its own caller's name on every slot. Slot callers are kept only when the set names more than one caller, or a caller other than its own.

`buildCcPrograms` titles a program `YYYY/MM/DD - Location` (Location alone without a parsed date, the date alone without a Location), and keeps `ProgramSlot.guestCaller` only when a set's slots name more than one caller or one other than the set's `Caller`.
